NBA DFS Picks for Friday, November 20 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Friday, November 20 · 6 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 20, 9:32 AM ET

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) is the top-projected player on the Friday, November 20 DraftKings main slate at 50.1 DraftKings points for $10,200. Cade Cunningham (DET, 49.4, $10,000) and Franz Wagner (ORL, 47.3, $9,700) are next.

Jalen Smith (CHI) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 5.74 projected points per $1,000 at $6,100.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 20, 9:32 AM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) at 50.1 projected DraftKings points for $10,200, Cade Cunningham (DET) at 49.4 projected DraftKings points for $10,000 and Franz Wagner (ORL) at 47.3 projected DraftKings points for $9,700 lead the SPAGS model on the DraftKings main slate, as of November 20, 9:32 AM ET.

Jalen Smith (CHI) at 5.74 projected points per $1,000 for $6,100, Tre Jones (CHI) at 5.64 projected points per $1,000 for $4,200 and Jalen Suggs (ORL) at 5.56 projected points per $1,000 for $5,400 lead the DraftKings main slate by SPAGS projection per dollar, as of November 20, 9:32 AM ET.
